sentences.text: Directions • adults and children 12 years of age and over: chew 2-4 tablets as symptoms occur, or as directed by a doctor.
Chew or crush tablets completely before swallowing.
• do not take for symptoms that persist for more than 2 weeks unless advised by a doctor
Warnings Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are presently taking a prescription drug.
Antacids may interact with certain prescription drugs.

When using this product • do not take more than 6 tablets in 24 hours • if pregnant do not take more than 6 tablets in 24 hours • do not use the maximum dosage for more than 2 weeks, except under the advice and supervision of a doctor Keep out of reach of children.
Active ingredient (per tablet) Calcium carbonate 750 mg
